        - name: metrics
          containerPort: 9090
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          privileged: false
        volumeMounts:
        - name: github-token
          mountPath: /etc/github
          readOnly: true
